name: Sicilian Scheveningen — Black Tactics
description: 4 strategic challenges for Black in the Scheveningen. Find the right counter-attacking plan!

drills.name: Nxg4: Punishing the Keres
drills.description: Black to play. White’s g4 lunge overextends — trade on d4 first, then collect the loose g-pawn.
drills.briefExplanation: cxd4! provokes Qxd4, and then Nxg4! wins the overextended pawn with tempo.
drills.explanation: Black to move. There is a real tactic here: cxd4 winning material. Line: 1. cxd4 Qxd4 2. Nxg4 Rg1 3. Nc6. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +4.09 for Black, 2.00 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
